    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AlertBox
    Implementation of the IAlertBox interface that uses JavaFX to display informational and warning alert dialogs in the Sudoku application.
    IAlertBox
    Interface that defines the structure for displaying alert boxes in the Sudoku application.
    Main
    Main class of the Sudoku application.
    SudokuBoard
    Represents the 6x6 Sudoku game board.
    SudokuController
    Controller class responsible for handling all user interactions and managing the logic for the Sudoku 6x6 game.
    SudokuGenerator
    Generates valid Sudoku 6x6 boards and prepares playable puzzles.
    SudokuValidator
    Provides validation logic for Sudoku 6x6 grids.
    SudokuView
    Represents the main game window (view) for the Sudoku 6x6 application.
    WelcomeController
    Controller class for the welcome screen of the Sudoku game.
    WelcomeView
    Represents the welcome view (initial window) of the Sudoku game.
